## Summary

Turn the existing offline synthetic evaluation and contract-only live canary into a reproducible live isolated-namespace relevance gate that establishes the baseline and measures every later delivery epic.

**Workstream key:** `EVAL`  
**Priority:** P0  
**Parent:** #320  
**Depends on:** None

## Scope

- Create a versioned relevance fixture corpus.
- Implement deterministic ranking metrics and versioned pass thresholds.
- Expose one end-to-end live gate through operator tooling or CI.

## Sub-issues

- [ ] #322 — Build isolated recall fixtures

- [ ] #324 — Wire the live recall gate

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] EVAL-1, EVAL-2, and EVAL-3 are closed.
- [ ] A documented current-system baseline exists.

## Validation

- [ ] Run the complete seed, query, score, and teardown path against a live throwaway namespace.
- [ ] Demonstrate that a deliberately degraded retrieval configuration fails the gate.

## Non-goals

- Changing retrieval algorithms.
- Expanding only synthetic evaluation without a live gate.

## Standing constraints

- Exact namespace and session-scope isolation remains a security boundary.
- Prompt placement stays client/runtime-owned; no implicit MCP `_meta` injection.
- Observability remains content-free.
- Dream planning remains dry-run-safe unless a separately authorized mutating wrapper is used.
